info.title: OpenVideoLibrary API
info.description: Native Rust preview API. No Jellyfin API compatibility. List reads omit entries whose media are inaccessible; positions retain saved ordering. Cursor is the next saved position for queues. Updates replace entries atomically and require the current Revision; stale writes return 409. Limits: 100 lists per account and 1000 entries per list. Expansion tables are additive to database schema v2.
